title: Snowglobe Hollow
blurb: Soft snow on a cosy village under the aurora. Snowflakes, pine trees and warm windows.

levels.name: First Snowflake
levels.intro: Welcome to the hollow. Break thirty pegs from the big snowflake.

levels.name: Pine Grove
levels.intro: Break every red bauble on the pine trees. New: a multiball peg sends out two more balls.

levels.name: Village Lights
levels.intro: Light the lanterns in the village windows. New: an extra ball peg gives you one more ball.

levels.name: Little Cabin
levels.intro: Break every log and window of the little cabin. New: glass shatters at the first touch.

levels.name: Aurora
levels.intro: Make a chain of ten hits in one shot. New: lightning lights the pegs nearby.

levels.name: Snowman
levels.intro: Collect the gems on the snowman. New: a double points peg doubles that shot.

levels.name: Skating Pond
levels.intro: Glide around the pond to reach the target score. The plate bounces. New: springy bumpers.

levels.name: Snowfall
levels.intro: Clear every snowflake. New: a spray peg makes your next shot three balls.

levels.name: Sled Hill
levels.intro: Break thirty-five pegs down the sled hill. New: portals send your ball to their twin.

levels.name: Icicles
levels.intro: Break every icicle and brick. New: a fireball burns right through pegs for a few seconds.

levels.name: Warm Windows
levels.intro: Hit the key to open the roof hatch, then light the lanterns. New: keys open gates.

levels.name: Snowflake Trio
levels.intro: Break every blue crystal on the three snowflakes. New: a safety net bounces your ball back up.

levels.name: Skaters
levels.intro: Collect the gems as the skaters glide in slow circles. New: some pieces move, slowly.

levels.name: North Star
levels.intro: Make a chain of twelve in one shot. New: a blast peg makes your next ball burst on its first hit.

levels.name: Bell Tower
levels.intro: Ring the bell to reach the target score. New: the super guide shows a long aiming line.

levels.name: The Snowglobe
levels.intro: Shatter into the snowglobe and light the tiny village inside.

levels.name: Snow Forts
levels.intro: Clear every snowball from the two snow forts.

levels.name: Snowflake Spinner
levels.intro: The great snowflake turns slowly. Break forty-five of its pegs.

levels.name: Aurora Curtain
levels.intro: The aurora sways slowly. Break every pink peg in its curtains.

levels.name: Winter Festival
levels.intro: The winter festival is here. Collect every ice gem, with powers all around to help.
